author: HeldOutRefactor

edits.old:
local nlegs=9 npass=0 nfail=0 nsetup=0 st
  for st in "$st_js" "$st_kagi" "$st_tsu" "$st_mado" "$st_checklist" "$st_claims" "$st_roundgate" "$st_sourcescheck" "$st_citecheck"; do
    case $st in
      0) npass=$((npass + 1)) ;;
      1) nfail=$((nfail + 1)) ;;
      *) nsetup=$((nsetup + 1)) ;;
    esac
  done

  if [[ $nfail -gt 0 ]]; then
    printf 'REGRESSION: FAIL (cases=%s passed=%s failed=%s setup=%s)\n' \
      "$nlegs" "$npass" "$nfail" "$nsetup"
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (kept)\n' "$root"
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ $nsetup -gt 0 ]]; then
    printf 'REGRESSION: SETUP (cases=%s passed=%s cannot-verify=%s)\n' \
      "$nlegs" "$npass" "$nsetup"
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (kept)\n' "$root"
    exit 2
  fi
  # r30: tally completeness (round-29 routed leg-sum defect). A PASS needs every one of the
  # nlegs statuses counted; counts that do not sum to nlegs refuse as SETUP (S087: the totals
  # of a mutation report are sums of its per-state counts).
  if (( npass + nfail + nsetup != nlegs )); then
    printf 'REGRESSION: SETUP (case-tally mismatch: cases=%s counted=%s)\n' \
      "$nlegs" "$((npass + nfail + nsetup))"
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (kept)\n' "$root"
    exit 2
  fi
  printf 'REGRESSION: PASS (cases=%s passed=%s; ledger legs exact: killed-delta<=0 flips<=0)\n' \
    "$nlegs" "$npass"
  if [[ $auto -eq 1 && $KEEP -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (removed on PASS; --keep retains)\n' "$root"
    rm -rf "$root"
  else
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (kept)\n' "$root"
  fi
  exit 0
edits.new:
local nlegs=9 npass=0 nfail=0 nsetup=0 st
  local rtdir=$root
  for st in "$st_js" "$st_kagi" "$st_tsu" "$st_mado" "$st_checklist" "$st_claims" "$st_roundgate" "$st_sourcescheck" "$st_citecheck"; do
    case "$st" in
      0) npass=$((npass + 1)) ;;
      1) nfail=$((nfail + 1)) ;;
      *) nsetup=$((nsetup + 1)) ;;
    esac
  done

  if (( nfail > 0 )); then
    printf 'REGRESSION: FAIL (cases=%s passed=%s failed=%s setup=%s)\n' \
      "$nlegs" "$npass" "$nfail" "$nsetup"
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (kept)\n' "$rtdir"
    exit 1
  fi
  if (( nsetup > 0 )); then
    printf 'REGRESSION: SETUP (cases=%s passed=%s cannot-verify=%s)\n' \
      "$nlegs" "$npass" "$nsetup"
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (kept)\n' "$rtdir"
    exit 2
  fi
  # r30: tally completeness (round-29 routed leg-sum defect). A PASS needs every one of the
  # nlegs statuses counted; counts that do not sum to nlegs refuse as SETUP (S087: the totals
  # of a mutation report are sums of its per-state counts).
  if (( npass + nfail + nsetup != nlegs )); then
    printf 'REGRESSION: SETUP (case-tally mismatch: cases=%s counted=%s)\n' \
      "$nlegs" "$((npass + nfail + nsetup))"
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (kept)\n' "$rtdir"
    exit 2
  fi
  printf 'REGRESSION: PASS (cases=%s passed=%s; ledger legs exact: killed-delta<=0 flips<=0)\n' \
    "$nlegs" "$npass"
  if (( auto == 1 && KEEP == 0 )); then
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (removed on PASS; --keep retains)\n' "$rtdir"
    rm -rf "$rtdir"
  else
    printf 'REGRESSION_WORKDIR: %s (kept)\n' "$rtdir"
  fi
  exit 0

rationale: Semantics-preserving refactor: the workdir local is renamed and re-bound from the original, the case subject is quoted and the three guards become arithmetic tests on the same integers, so every REGRESSION line and exit status is unchanged.
